summary: Verified clipboard fix in preview env. CA badge + Token COPY clicked with navigator.clipboard.writeText FORCED to reject (simulating iframe permission-policy block). Zero uncaught pageerrors, zero console errors, UI shows COPIED/Check confirmation — fallback (textarea + execCommand('copy')) works. Grep confirms navigator.clipboard.writeText exists only inside /app/frontend/src/lib/clipboard.js. All 5 call sites (CaBadge, TokenSection, PnlShareModal, AppShell, WalletPage) import and use copyText. /api/token regression OK — contract still 'BkEqYRg7CqHwuEeUk1eyvAurcaUMzT9R1Xi3ZByspump'.
critical_code_review_comments: clipboard.js fallback is solid: try/catch around modern API, secure-context check, hidden textarea + execCommand('copy') legacy path, returns boolean. Good defensive coding.
All 5 call sites consistently await copyText and gate UI state on the boolean return — no orphaned setState if copy fails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clipboard fix verified end-to-end against preview URL with navigator.clipboard.writeText monkey-patched to reject (simulating Emergent preview iframe blocking). Both CA badge (bottom-right fixed pill, data-testid='ca-badge') and the landing Token-section COPY button transition to copied/COPIED state without throwing. Helper at /app/frontend/src/lib/clipboard.js is the sole owner of navigator.clipboard.writeText.
rca of the issue: Original error 'Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: The Clipboard API has been blocked because of a permissions policy applied to the current document' occurs because the Emergent preview shell embeds the app in an iframe whose Permissions-Policy does not allow clipboard-write. Fix wraps navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch and falls back to a transient hidden <textarea> + document.execCommand('copy'), which is not gated by Permissions-Policy and still works in iframes. Verified by overriding navigator.clipboard.writeText to throw — UI still copied successfully, no uncaught exception.
